weeks.content:
Choose my best five works
Mount and label

Talk about my art
Write my artist line

Present to another class
Answer their questions

Make art for the school wall
Legacy mural tile

Make presents for parents
Wrap with our paper

Draw my nursery memories
Pages of my journey

Design our graduating flag
Vote and sew

Final stage dressing
Curtain and flowers

Full dress rehearsal
Every crew in place

Our art on the big day
Proud send off
